C90B Immediate Action Items.
Emergency Engine Shutdown.
Autopilot. Disconnect. Affected engine. Condition Lever. Cut-off. Propeller Lever. Feather. Fuel Firewall Shutoff Valve. Close. Fire extinguisher, if installed. Actuate. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 1.
Engine Failure After Liftoff.
Maximum Continuous Power. Set. Air speed. Maintain, takeoff speed or above. Propeller, inoperative engine. Verify feathered or feather. Airspeed, After obstacles cleared. 108 knots. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 2.
Engine Failure During Ground Roll.
Power levers. Ground fine. Brakes. Maximum. If insufficient runway remains for stopping. Condition Lever. Cut-off. Fuel Firewall Shutoff Valve. Close. Master switch. Off, Gang bar down. Boost Pumps. Off. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 2.
Engine Fire on ground.
Condition Lever. Cut-off. Fuel Firewall Shutoff Valve. Close. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 1.
Engine Failure in Flight below V M C A .
Power. Reduce as required to maintain control. Nose. Lower to accelerate above V M C A . Power. As required. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 2.
Second Engine Flame out.
Power Lever. Idle. Propeller Lever. Do, not, feather. Condition Lever. Fuel Cutoff. Conduct air-start. Abnormal procedures, tab 1. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 2.
Use of oxygen, electrical smoke or fire, environmental system smoke or fumes, or pressurization loss.
Oxygen system control. Confirm on. Crew. Don mask. For smoke and fumes. Mask Selector. Emergency Position. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 6.
Cabin door unlocked.
All occupants. Seated with seat belts fastened. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 4.
Emergency Descent.
Power levers. Idle. Propeller Levers. High RPM. Flaps, 184 knots maximum. Approach. Landing gear, 182 maximum. Down. Airspeed. 182 knots maximum. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 4.
Emergency Glide.
Landing gear. Up. Flaps. Up. Propellers. Feathered. Airspeed. 125 knots. Glide ratio. 1.8 nautical miles per 1000 feet. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 4.
Autopilot Malfunction, elevator trim runaway, Collins FCS 65H autopilot.
Control Wheel. Hold firmly, be prepared to accept control wheel forces. Autopilot yaw damp trim disconnect button. Depress fully. Flight controls, power levers. As required to recover the airplane. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 5.
Autopilot Malfunction, elevator trim runaway, Garmin GFC 600 autopilot.
Control Wheel. Grip firmly. Autopilot disconnect, trim interrupt button. Press and hold. Aircraft attitude. maintain, regain control. Reference. Garmin GFC 600 autopilot airplane flight manual supplement.
Unscheduled Rudder Boost Activation.
Rudder Boost. Off. Rudder Trim. As required. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 5.
High differential pressure.
Cabin altitude controller. Select higher cabin altitude setting. If condition persists. Bleed air valves. Closed. Cabin Pressure, after cabin is depressurized. Dump. Bleed air valve. Open. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 6.
Emergency Exit.
Emergency release hatch cover. open. Release button. Push. If release button will not push, pull hooks to override pressure lock and then push the release button. Pull handle and push out hatch. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 6.
Spins Recovery.
Control Column. Full forward, Ailerons neutral. Full Rudder. Opposite direction of spin. Power levers. Idle. Rudder. Neutralize when rotation stops. Execute a smooth pullout. Reference. Emergency Procedures Tab 7.
TAWS Warning.
Wings. Level. Power. Max Allowable. Pitch. Increase first to 20 degrees. Adjust to avoid stall. Aim for 101 knots. Gear and Flaps. Retract.
End checklist memory items.
